title: The Survey Map
blurb: Doc Whitlow needs a Queen Spider gland, and he pays in maps. Hold the webbing waves, bring her down, and mail the gland from your noticeboard.

objective.text: Bring Down the Queen Spider and Mail Her Gland

telegram.title: Wanted: One Gland
telegram.body: DOC WHITLOW NEEDS A QUEEN SPIDER GLAND STOP SHE CLIMBS THE BUTTES THIS WEEK STOP DROP HER AND MAIL THE GLAND FROM YOUR NOTICEBOARD STOP DO NOT EAT IT STOP

build: Whitlow here, from the rail car. I need a fresh Queen Spider gland. Fresh means quickly.
Doc pays in maps. The survey map. The one the railroad swears doesn't exist.
wave: Webs on the walls tonight. Shoot through them, or burn them.

build: That survey map got three men fired and one man eaten. I was one of the fired.
wave: Spiders before a queen. She sends scouts. Fascinating. Terrible, but fascinating.

build: Word at the tables: the Queen Spider moves tonight. I'd bet on you. Small stakes.
wave: Big one in the tunnel. That's her. Bring her down and grab that gland.

drop: The gland! Carry it to a noticeboard. My mail hook will find it.
pickup: Hold it upright, please. It is, regrettably, still thinking.
delivered: Received. Still warm. Splendid. You'll have your map, ranchers.
hold: Walls are quiet. Now get that gland to a noticeboard before it stops thinking.
win: That map says the tunnel runs deeper than the railroad let on. Much deeper.
lost: A pity. Spiders keep. Houses, it seems, do not. Again, please.

journal.title: The Survey Map
journal.body:
Survey tunnel, mile three: a hollow chamber, warm air, and a sound like breathing. The crew refused to go on. So did I.

The railroad drew a wall across the map and called it rock. It is not rock.

- E. Whitlow, Rail Car 9

headline_win: Queen Spider Felled; Gland 'Still Thinking', Says Doc
